list.title: LLM Connections
list.description: Connect your LLM services to enable evaluations and playground features. Your provider will charge based on usage.
list.accessDeniedDescription: You do not have permission to view LLM API keys for this project.

delete.title: Delete LLM Connection
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete this connection? This action cannot be undone.

validation.providerRequired: Please add a provider name that identifies this connection.
validation.providerNoColons: Provider name cannot contain colons. Use a format like 'OpenRouter_Mistral' instead.
validation.awsAccessKeyRequired: AWS Access Key ID is required.
validation.awsSecretAccessKeyRequired: AWS Secret Access Key is required.
validation.customModelRequired: At least one custom model is required for this adapter.
validation.customModelRequiredWithoutDefaults: At least one custom model name is required when default models are disabled.
validation.vertexServiceAccountRequired: GCP service account JSON key is required for Vertex AI.

adapter.label: LLM adapter
adapter.description: Schema that is accepted at that provider endpoint.
adapter.otherModelDescription: You can use any model provider as an LLM connection if it supports one of the adapters in the list. Many providers support the OpenAI API schema, such as Z.ai, OpenRouter, Qwen, Mistral, Hugging Face, and more. Replace the API Base URL with the model endpoint, then add your provider's custom model names and API key.

provider.label: Provider name
provider.description: Key to identify the connection within Langfuse. Cannot contain colons.

customModels.label: Custom models
customModels.description: Custom model names accepted by the given endpoint.
customModels.azureDescription: For Azure, the model name should be the same as the deployment name in Azure. For evals, choose a model with function calling capabilities.
customModels.bedrockDescription: For Bedrock, the model name is the Bedrock Inference Profile ID, e.g. 'eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6'

extraHeaders.label: Extra Headers
extraHeaders.cloudDescription: Optional additional HTTP headers to include with requests to the LLM provider. All header values are stored encrypted on our servers.
extraHeaders.selfHostedDescription: Optional additional HTTP headers to include with requests to the LLM provider. All header values are stored encrypted in your database.

authentication.label: Authentication Method
authentication.description: Select how Langfuse should authenticate to Bedrock.

aws.bedrockApiKeyUpdateDescription: Use <link>Amazon Bedrock API keys</link> to replace the current authentication.
aws.keepExistingDescription: Leave empty to keep existing credentials. To update, provide both Access Key ID and Secret Access Key.
aws.provideBothDescription: Provide both Access Key ID and Secret Access Key.
aws.cloudAccessKeysDescription: These should be long-lived credentials for an AWS user with `bedrock:InvokeModel` permission.
aws.selfHostedAccessKeysDescription: For self-hosted deployments, AWS credentials are optional. When omitted, authentication will use the AWS SDK default credential provider chain.
aws.defaultChainDescription: When AWS credentials are omitted, the system will automatically check for credentials in this order:
aws.learnMore: Learn more about AWS credential providers →

vertex.useAdcDescription: When enabled, authentication uses the GCP environment's default credentials instead of a service account key.
vertex.cloudStorageDescription: Your API keys are stored encrypted on our servers.
vertex.selfHostedStorageDescription: Your API keys are stored encrypted in your database.
vertex.serviceAccountDescription: Paste your GCP service account JSON key here. The service account must have `Vertex AI User` role permissions. Example JSON:
vertex.adcDescription: When enabled, the system will automatically check for credentials in this order:
vertex.gcloudCredentials: gcloud CLI credentials (gcloud auth application-default login)
vertex.learnMore: Learn more about GCP Application Default Credentials →

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.cloudStorageDescription: Your API keys are stored encrypted on our servers.
apiKey.selfHostedStorageDescription: Your API keys are stored encrypted in your database.

baseUrl.label: API Base URL
baseUrl.azureDescription: Please add the base URL in the following format (or compatible API): {format}
baseUrl.defaultDescription: Leave blank to use the default base URL for the given LLM adapter.

vertexLocation.label: Location (Optional)
vertexLocation.description: Google Cloud region (e.g., global, us-central1, europe-west4). Defaults to <global>global</global> as required for Gemini 3 models.

responsesApi.label: Use Responses API
responsesApi.description: Route OpenAI requests through the Responses API instead of Chat Completions.

defaultModels.label: Enable default models
defaultModels.description: Default models for the selected adapter will be available in Langfuse features.
